title: Answer: Pioneer data should show an acceleration toward the solar apex

statements.text: Because the Sun moves through the galaxy, planetary orbits are helices, and a spacecraft moving outward meets drag with a 9:1 radial-to-axial ratio. The predicted signature is an unmodeled axial acceleration of about $10^{-11}$ m/s$^2$ toward the solar apex, which thermal explanations of the Pioneer anomaly do not give.
statements.falsification_criteria: A reanalysis of Pioneer 10 and 11 Doppler data that finds no acceleration component toward the solar apex at that level.

prediction.resolution_criterion: A reanalysis of Pioneer 10 and 11 tracking data finds an axial acceleration of order $10^{-11}$ m/s$^2$ directed toward the solar apex, beyond the thermal-recoil model.
